answer: A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. Because the knoll beacon is unpredictable until close, the gale panel cannot be arranged, and the pearl audit records the draw inputs for every case. The 7 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
